objetos_reliquias.efecto_literal: For traits, each of your Normal Pokémon also counts as one of the enemy team's types: the most common enemy type goes to your first Normal Pokémon, the next most common to the second, and so on.
objetos_reliquias.fuente: Pantalla ITEMS > ITEM GUIDE (texto corto de carta), sesión anónima

objetos_reliquias.efecto_literal: Each time any enemy gets a stat drop, your Pokémon in battle heals 5% of its max HP. It heals once per drop, however many stages were lost.
objetos_reliquias.fuente: Pantalla ITEMS > ITEM GUIDE (texto corto de carta), sesión anónima

objetos_reliquias.efecto_literal: When an enemy faints, your active Pokémon gets +1 to 3 different random stats. Does not trigger on the last enemy of a fight.
objetos_reliquias.fuente: Pantalla ITEMS > ITEM GUIDE (texto corto de carta), sesión anónima

objetos_reliquias.efecto_literal: Your Flying Pokémon may dodge attacks: chance = half their Speed ÷ (half their Speed + the attacker's Speed). Equal Speed gives 33%, twice as fast gives 50%.
objetos_reliquias.fuente: Pantalla ITEMS > ITEM GUIDE (texto corto de carta), sesión anónima

objetos_reliquias.efecto_literal: Any enemy with at least one poison stack deals −30% damage to all of your Pokémon.
objetos_reliquias.fuente: Pantalla ITEMS > ITEM GUIDE (texto corto de carta), sesión anónima

objetos_reliquias.efecto_literal: When one of your Bug Pokémon is knocked out, your next living Bug Pokémon in team order gets +2 ATK, +2 Sp.ATK and +2 Speed.
objetos_reliquias.fuente: Pantalla ITEMS > ITEM GUIDE (texto corto de carta), sesión anónima

objetos_reliquias.efecto_literal: At the end of each turn, your Pokémon in battle heals 5% of its max HP for each stat boost it has (+3 ATK and +1 DEF = 4 boosts = 20%).
objetos_reliquias.fuente: Pantalla ITEMS > ITEM GUIDE (texto corto de carta), sesión anónima
